degree_rationale: Treats the foundational duality of life and death as essences, each tree having its own five members (mind, thought, teaching, counsel, reflection) that ARE the cosmic powers themselves (Pillar of Glory, Jesus, First Man, Ambassador, Father / vs. their bitter counterparts). This is essence-mapping, not mechanism.
direction_rationale: Foundational duality being set forth at the originating point of the corpus — life-vs-death as primal divergence. Generative-declarative tone, like teaching 1.
grand_man_function: The dual root of celestial willing — the love of good and its opposite, before any operation. Heart-inmost in its primal twofold.
title: The Two Trees: how Life and Death are structured through corresponding members
